title: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) use in early pregnancy linked to smaller ovaries and testes | New Scientist
description: Taking the painkiller paracetamol (acetaminophen) during pregnancy has been linked to smaller ovaries and testes in baby girls and boys, but that doesn't mean it directly caused them or affects fertility
author: Michael Le Page

title: OpenAI has solved the Navier-Stokes Millennium problem using $15m of AI effort | New Scientist
description: One of the trickiest problems in mathematics has now fallen to AI after just days of work. The groundbreaking result was announced amid rumour after similar, but less complete work, also created with AI, was announced just hours before
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Why growing seaweed isn't a climate solution | New Scientist
description: Some have claimed cultivating seaweed could remove hundreds of millions of tonnes of CO2. But as warming waters kill off kelp, we need to refocus on preserving what we have, a study argues
author: Alec Luhn

title: Zapping the face could boost brain signalling and memory | New Scientist
description: Bursts of electrical stimulation to a nerve in the face seem to improve signalling between neurons and people's performance on a memory test
author: Rachel Melegrito

title: Major breakthrough made on famous Millennium maths problem | New Scientist
description: Three key findings produced in collaboration between humans and AI bring us closer to a solution to the infamous Navier-Stokes puzzle
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Super El Niño set to cause 'terribly dangerous' drought in the Amazon | New Scientist
description: The El Niño phase now under way will be the most damaging on record for the Amazon, scientists warn, raising the risk of catastrophic wildfires
author: Madeleine Cuff
